title: Meanwhile, at the Printer
content: The Japanese edition of Imaginative Realism is on its way. It is being produced byBorn Digital,one of the finest publishers of science fiction and fantasy art.Here’s what the cover will look like.And here’s some of the back cover copy.Also, the US publisher Andrews McMeel has just announced that the English language edition ofImaginative Realismis going back for its fifth printing.Color and Lightis going into its second printing, just five weeks after release.
